name: coffer
description: Coffer command runner for independent frontend and backend projects

scripts.dev: pnpm --dir frontend dev & pnpm --dir backend dev & wait
scripts.build: pnpm --dir frontend build && pnpm --dir backend build
scripts.lint: pnpm --dir frontend lint && pnpm --dir backend lint
scripts.format:check: pnpm --dir frontend format:check && pnpm --dir backend format:check
scripts.typecheck: pnpm --dir frontend typecheck && pnpm --dir backend typecheck
scripts.contracts:fmt: cargo fmt --manifest-path contracts/near-policy/Cargo.toml --check && cargo fmt --manifest-path contracts/test-token/Cargo.toml --check && cargo fmt --manifest-path contracts/policy-factory/Cargo.toml --check
scripts.contracts:lint: cargo clippy --manifest-path contracts/near-policy/Cargo.toml --all-targets --locked -- -D warnings && cargo clippy --manifest-path contracts/test-token/Cargo.toml --all-targets --locked -- -D warnings && cargo clippy --manifest-path contracts/policy-factory/Cargo.toml --all-targets --locked -- -D warnings
scripts.contracts:test: cargo test --manifest-path contracts/near-policy/Cargo.toml --locked && cargo test --manifest-path contracts/test-token/Cargo.toml --locked && cargo test --manifest-path contracts/policy-factory/Cargo.toml --locked
scripts.contracts:check: cargo check --manifest-path contracts/near-policy/Cargo.toml --target wasm32-unknown-unknown --locked && cargo check --manifest-path contracts/test-token/Cargo.toml --target wasm32-unknown-unknown --locked && cargo check --manifest-path contracts/policy-factory/Cargo.toml --target wasm32-unknown-unknown --locked
scripts.contracts:build: cargo near build non-reproducible-wasm --manifest-path contracts/near-policy/Cargo.toml --locked && cargo near build non-reproducible-wasm --manifest-path contracts/test-token/Cargo.toml --locked && cargo near build non-reproducible-wasm --manifest-path contracts/policy-factory/Cargo.toml --locked
